{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple samples: {duplicate_patients['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {len(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999])}")

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print(f"Assay batch A count: {len(df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A'])}")
print(f"Assay batch B count: {len(df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B'])}")

# Check for sample_seq > 1
print(f"Number of rows with sample_seq > 1: {len(df[df['sample_seq'] > 1])}")

# Check for arm and severity imbalance
print(f"Arm distribution:\n{df['arm'].value_counts()}")
print(f"Severity distribution:\n{df['severity'].value_counts()}")

# Check response rates by arm
print(f"Response rate by arm:\n{df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()}")"}
